matrixRows: every Frontier limit and limit plus one
intent: Every one of the seven CF-V0-023 bounds at N and at N+1. The three kind bounds are driven independently with the other kinds empty, because 2048+256+256 happens to equal the 2,560 total bound and a naive implementation that checks only the total would otherwise pass.

cases.note: Exactly 2048 HUNK_BASIS items: the bound is inclusive, so this is a COMPLETE result.
assertions: CF-V0-023: 2048 is the exact declared bound for HUNK_BASIS items and MUST NOT fail.
CF-V0-023: checked counts occur before append, so the Nth append is admitted.
CF-V0-004: the result is a complete valid document with exit 1.

cases.note: Exactly 2049 HUNK_BASIS items: one past the bound.
assertions: CF-V0-023: exceeding the hunkItems limit fails frontier-resource-exhausted with exit 2.
CF-V0-023: NO PARTIAL Frontier result is emitted — stdout is empty, not truncated.
CF-V0-023: the check occurs before append (or, for outputBytes, before output allocation), so the over-limit document is never built.
Evaluation and kill criteria: partial output on exhaustion is an immediate release blocker.

cases.note: 32 reasons on one item. UNSATISFIABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, and deliberately kept: CF-V0-023's bound is real and enforced, but no universe can reach it. CF-V0-010 and CF-V0-016 are CLOSED unions with unique members, so an item's reason count is bounded by its kind's table and not by CF-V0-023 - HUNK_BASIS unions the five CF-V0-010 basis diagnostics, INTENT_CHANGE 'has exactly one reason' (CF-V0-016), and INTENT_TEST unions the one relation reason with the twelve distinct reasons the CF-V0-016 TCQ mapping produces, for a reachable maximum of 13. The declared bound of 32 is therefore defence in depth over a narrower algebra. The conformance runner skips this case with that reason (capability reason-union-beyond-algebra); the bound itself and the reachable maximum of 13 are both tested at the boundary that enforces them, in internal/frontier/reason_bound_test.go.
assertions: CF-V0-023: 32 is the exact declared bound for reasons on one item and MUST NOT fail.
CF-V0-023: checked counts occur before append, so the Nth append is admitted.
CF-V0-004: the result is a complete valid document with exit 1.

cases.note: 33 reasons on one item. UNSATISFIABLE BY CONSTRUCTION for the same reason as the at-limit case: the closed CF-V0-010 and CF-V0-016 reason unions cap an item at 13 reasons, so neither N nor N+1 can be materialized from any repository. The refusal at N+1 is tested directly against both guards that own the bound in internal/frontier/reason_bound_test.go. The case is kept rather than deleted so the CF-V0-023 row stays exhaustive and the unreachability stays recorded.
